message.content:
Add COD (Cash on Delivery) availability and Return/Exchange Policy fields to the Zip Code Checker app at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code.

## Step 1: Read these files completely first
1. `prisma/schema.prisma` — understand ZipCode model and WidgetConfig model
2. `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` — understand action handlers (create, edit intents), modal form fields, table columns, state variables

---

## Step 2: Update Prisma schema

In `prisma/schema.prisma`, add to the `ZipCode` model (after the `eta` field):
```prisma
codAvailable  Boolean?
returnPolicy  String?
```

Also add to `WidgetConfig` model (after `showWaitlistOnFailure`):
```prisma
showCod          Boolean  @default(true)
showReturnPolicy Boolean  @default(true)
```

Run the migration:
```bash
cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code" && npx prisma migrate dev --name add_cod_return_policy
```

Then regenerate Prisma client:
```bash
cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code" && npx prisma generate
```

---

## Step 3: Update app.zip-codes.tsx action handlers

### For the "create" and "update" (edit) intents:
Parse these new fields from formData:
```typescript
const codAvailableRaw = formData.get("codAvailable") as string | null;
const codAvailable = codAvailableRaw === "true" ? true : codAvailableRaw === "false" ? false : null;
const returnPolicy = (formData.get("returnPolicy") as string | null) || null;
```

Include them in `db.zipCode.create({ data: { ..., codAvailable, returnPolicy } })` and `db.zipCode.update({ data: { ..., codAvailable, returnPolicy } })`.

### For CSV import:
Update the sample CSV header and parser to support two additional optional columns: `COD` and `Return Policy`.
Update sample CSV to: `Zip Code,Zone,Status,Message,ETA,COD,Return Policy`
When parsing rows, read index 5 as COD ("yes"/"true"/"1" → true, "no"/"false"/"0" → false, else null) and index 6 as returnPolicy string.

---

## Step 4: Add state variables for add/edit modal

Add these state variables near the other edit* state vars:
```typescript
const [editCodAvailable, setEditCodAvailable] = useState<string>(""); // "", "true", "false"
const [editReturnPolicy, setEditReturnPolicy] = useState("");
```

When opening the edit modal (the handler that sets modal open + pre-fills fields), also set:
```typescript
setEditCodAvailable(
  zip.codAvailable === true ? "true" : zip.codAvailable === false ? "false" : ""
);
setEditReturnPolicy(zip.returnPolicy ?? "");
```

When opening the ADD modal (resetting fields), also reset:
```typescript
setEditCodAvailable("");
setEditReturnPolicy("");
```

---

## Step 5: Add fields to the add/edit modal form

Inside the modal form (the Modal.Section with all the TextField inputs), add AFTER the ETA field:

```tsx
<Select
  label="Cash on Delivery (COD)"
  options={[
    { label: "Not specified", value: "" },
    { label: "COD Available", value: "true" },
    { label: "COD Not Available", value: "false" },
  ]}
  value={editCodAvailable}
  onChange={setEditCodAvailable}
  helpText="Show customers whether cash on delivery is available for this ZIP."
/>
<input type="hidden" name="codAvailable" value={editCodAvailable} />
<TextField
  label="Return/Exchange Policy"
  value={editReturnPolicy}
  onChange={setEditReturnPolicy}
  multiline={3}
  placeholder="30-day returns accepted. Exchange within 7 days."
  autoComplete="off"
  name="returnPolicy"
  helpText="Optional return policy shown to customers for this ZIP code."
/>
```

---

## Step 6: Add COD badge to the ZIP codes table

In the DataTable or IndexTable columns, add a "COD" column. For each row, show:
- Green badge "COD ✓" if `codAvailable === true`
- Red badge "No COD" if `codAvailable === false`  
- Empty if null

Use Polaris `Badge` component:
```tsx
{zip.codAvailable === true && <Badge tone="success">COD</Badge>}
{zip.codAvailable === false && <Badge tone="critical">No COD</Badge>}
```

---

## Final Step:
Run: `cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code" && npm run typecheck`
Fix ALL TypeScript errors before finishing.
Run: `cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code" && npm run lint`
Fix ALL lint errors.

Read every file completely before making changes. Follow existing Polaris v13 patterns exactly.
